name: Are my files uploaded when splitting a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree splits PDFs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Files never leave your device. You can verify this yourself: open your browser's DevTools → Network tab — you should not see your PDF being uploaded to a remote server during processing.

name: What page range format does PDFree accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter comma-separated pages and ranges: for example 1, 3-7, 12, 15-20. Spaces are optional. You can also click individual page thumbnails to select or deselect them visually, or use quick-select buttons for odd pages, even pages, or halves of the document.

name: Can I split only specific pages from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can extract a custom page range (e.g. pages 3-7) or split every page into individual files. Enter the range as comma-separated values like '1-5, 8, 11-15', or click pages visually in the thumbnail grid.

name: How do I delete or remove a specific page from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select all pages except the ones you want to remove, then click Split PDF to extract only the pages you want to keep. For example, to delete page 3 from a 10-page PDF, select pages 1-2 and 4-10 and extract them. The result is your PDF without the removed pages — original quality preserved.

name: Is there a page limit for splitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no page or file size limits. Processing depends on your device's available memory. PDFs with hundreds of pages render thumbnails in seconds on a modern computer.

name: Can I split a PDF offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a Progressive Web App and works fully offline once loaded in your browser. No internet connection is required to split or extract pages.

name: Can I split a password-protected PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you know the password. When you open a protected PDF, PDFree will prompt you to enter it. Once unlocked, you can select and extract pages normally. PDFree cannot bypass or crack a password — it can only open files you are authorised to open.

name: How do I split a PDF on iPhone, iPad, or Mac without Adobe Acrobat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open PDFree in Safari (iPhone/iPad) or any browser on Mac — no app download or Adobe Acrobat required. The tool runs entirely in the browser: load your PDF, select pages, tap Split PDF. The result saves to your Files app on iOS or your Downloads folder on Mac.

name: Can I split multiple PDF files at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in a single batch — PDFree processes one PDF at a time. Open the tool in a new tab to split a second file in parallel. PDFree also works offline as a Progressive Web App, so there is no network wait between files.

name: Is this PDF splitter completely free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a completely free PDF splitter — no subscription, no sign up, no watermarks on the output, and no daily limits. Split or separate as many PDFs as you need.

name: Can I unmerge a PDF back into separate files?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Select the page ranges that correspond to each original document and extract them as separate PDFs. This unmerges the combined file back into its individual parts — same operation as splitting, applied in reverse.

name: How are the individual page files named?

acceptedAnswer.text: Files are named page-001.pdf, page-002.pdf, etc. with leading zeros for correct alphabetical sort order.

name: Does PDFree add a watermark when splitting PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree never adds watermarks to output files. The split pages are the exact content from your original PDF — no logo, no 'Created with PDFree' stamp, no advertising mark. Many free online PDF tools add watermarks to encourage upgrades; PDFree doesn't because there is no paid plan to upgrade to.
